rationale: Updated the explicit local icon integration test to create and remove a disposable Flyway-migrated schema, seed three bank rows for a registered fixture account, and read them through an explicit AccountScope. This ensures the icon URL and foreign-key route checks run with representative bank data without relying on a default account or modifying the normal database contents. The focused test could not run because the Maven wrapper requires a PowerShell command unavailable in this environment.

repo.Db.TEST_SCHEMA_PROPERTY selects the disposable schema used by the real-database icon route checks.
test_specifications: Apply the checked-in Flyway migrations in a unique disposable PostgreSQL schema. Seed all referenced shared items before dependent rows, then seed two registered accounts with distinct recipes and bank, materials, and character inventory rows.
Delete account-dependent rows in FK-safe order, remove registry rows, and verify global icon selection returns [10, 11, 30, 31, 40, 41].
With both accounts registered, verify the global icon selection remains shared and the scoped account selections are [20, 22, 24] for A and [21, 23, 25] for B.
Verify scoped Profit and Discovery selections exclude foreign account recipe rows while global selection includes the shared crafting graph.
Insert a fresh shared quote for item 10 and verify the quote is reused across demands while only required stale or missing IDs remain selected.

For each ItemIconApiRealDbIT case, create a unique disposable migrated schema, seed a registered account, three shared items with accepted icon metadata, and three bank slots. Read bank rows using AccountScope, exercise icon routes and the foreign-key route check, then drop the schema.
